keyword: rock n roll hall of fame 2026 inductees
claims: The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame announced its 2026 inductees.
The official 2026 Inductees page confirms Oasis, Phil Collins, Iron Maiden, Sade, Billy Idol, Wu-Tang Clan, Luther Vandross, and Joy Division/New Order as the newest class.
The induction ceremony is scheduled for late 2026.
Oasis makes it in on their third nomination.
Phil Collins is inducted as a solo artist.
Phil Collins was previously inducted as a member of Genesis.
The Early Influence Award recipients are Celia Cruz, Fela Kuti, Queen Latifah, MC Lyte, and Gram Parsons.
The Musical Excellence Award recipients are Linda Creed, Arif Mardin, Jimmy Miller, and Rick Rubin.
The Ahmet Ertegun Award recipient is Ed Sullivan.
The 2026 induction ceremony will honor these artists.
